answer_1.quote: Pre-trained Transformers have brought tremendous progress in summarizing text in an abstract manner ...

answer_2.quote: We adapt evaluation metrics proposed in prior works to the long document settings and correlate their metric scores with average human relevance and factual consistency scores.

answer_4.quote: We then perform fine-grained human analysis on the model outputs by three human annotators to qualitatively assess whether long document abstractive models can generate relevant and factually consistent summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated summary on relevance and factual consistency.
